summary.en: BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual entry in AI4Science
summary.zh: BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）AI for Science年度条目

description.en:
BenchCouncil lists ESMFold in the AI4Science area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Evolutionary-scale prediction of atomic-level protein structure with a language model”. The page names Zeming Lin, Halil Akin, Roshan Rao, Brian Hie, Alexander Rives as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
